scaleBeatText: A woman, maybe 30s, with restless hands walks away from Haven. They don't look back.

With Haven grieving, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Thornfield's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.
🚶 Haven walks from the table cleanly — no blades, no hard words. The bond ends where it stood, honestly.

📯 The Red Table's court summons Haven's speaker. SWEAR the oath of the realm (a gift seals it), SERVE at their court (seven days of your speaker's life), or WALK — break the link and stay a free fire, refusing the scale itself with it (the offer does not return). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.

◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. The System does not apologize this time. "WE PRICED THE RUN. NO HUNGER ON THE RECORD — THE PELLET HUMS WHERE THE FIRE SHOULD BE. NO FEAST, NO SURGE, NOTHING HERE WE CAN PRICE. A COLD SPOT AT EVERY TABLE: THE WORDS WERE ON THE WRAPPER." The ledger still wants: wave-3 monsters faced. The mantle may pass to hungrier hands; the table will still be here.
Almost nobody walks away from this one.

The table is green felt under white light. Across it: Vex of the Ninth Ledger — seventeen limbs, zero losses on camera, and a smile like a tax form.
Nobody's beaten Vex on camera. The veterans just say "don't think at the table." They won't say why.
📺 The last roll. Everything staked is in the middle of the table, and the dice are in your hand.
Almost nobody walks away from this one.
